scripts.dev: npm run build && node scripts/with-local-env.mjs node node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js -k -n frontend,backend,licenses,notifications "npm run dev -w @app/frontend" "npm run dev -w @app/backend" "npm run dev -w @app/license-service" "npm run dev -w @app/notification-worker"
scripts.build:packages: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @app/contracts -w @app/license-core -w @app/database -w @app/messaging
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @app/backend -w @app/license-service -w @app/notification-worker -w @app/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts apps/backend/test/*.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:packages && node scripts/test-setup.mjs && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/integration/*.test.ts
